C1134.title: UK Qian Zhimin Case: 61,000 Bitcoin Money Laundering
C1134.summary: Qian Zhimin used approximately 1.14 billion yuan raised from illegal fundraising through Lantian Gerui to purchase Bitcoin. After fleeing to the UK, she converted the Bitcoin into cash and luxury goods through her assistant Wen Jian.
